items.title: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Weigh Split Plans
items.summary: Price targets for Keurig Dr Pepper have shifted toward the low to low mid US$40 range, with recent moves into the US$38 to US$41 band from firms such as JPMorgan. Analysts link these adjustments to how the stock lines up against beverage growth prospects, coffee segment challenges, and the planned split into Global Coffee Co and Beverage Co by early 2027.
